scope: Owner-initiated CSV transaction export and versioned JSON data export v1
included: Minimal profile metadata (display name, locale, timezone, and preferred currency); provider user ID and email are excluded.
Active and archived wallets and categories.
All confirmed finance events, including status, reversals/refunds, exact decimal-string amounts, category allocations, and wallet/category labels.
CSV transaction rows with spreadsheet-formula protection for text fields.
safety: Pagination follows the authenticated same-origin Hono API and detects missing, repeated, or empty cursors.
The browser fails without creating a partial file above 25,000 events.
Draf lokal dan hasil OCR yang belum terkonfirmasi tidak dimasukkan.

security.limitation: Heuristic artifact scan; not a live staging auth/RLS audit.

exportAndDateFilterE2e.command: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/venfinance-wrangler-dev WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false ./tools/pnpm.sh test:e2e --grep 'owner backup exports|transaction date filters'

refundE2e.command: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/venfinance-wrangler-dev WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false ./tools/pnpm.sh test:e2e --grep 'refund starts from its posted expense'

limitations: Backup v1 currently covers profile, wallets, categories, and finance events. Budget plans/period history, debts (not yet implemented in the repository), and attachment blobs need dedicated export handling before this is the complete product-wide export required by FIN-034.
Attachment export remains a separate operation as required by the product contract.
The 25,000-event browser ceiling is fail-closed and visible as an export error; there is no silent truncation.
releaseState: Code and local QA only. No Neon migration or production deployment was performed; no task was marked done based only on this evidence.
